scope: All 36 residual sohran- tokens in the live v019 Latin reader, all in base-papers1-43-isv.tex.
choice: Normalize the non-headword sohran- layer to the official type-1 shranjati/shranjenje family while preserving aspect, tense, voice, case, number, gender, and sentence structure.
motivation: Every occurrence means preservation or conservation: mathematical relations, ranks, regularity, properties, forms, and physical conservation laws. The official dictionary supplies shranjati for preserve and shranjenje for preservation/conservation. The current sohran- spelling duplicates the Russian-shaped initial vowel without being the official Interslavic lemma. The alternative ohranjati means guard/protect and would be semantically weaker for mathematical invariance and Erhaltungsgesetze.
alternatives_rejected: Keep sohran- as an intelligible regional doublet: it is not the pinned official headword and preserves a Russian-shaped corpus inconsistency.
Replace the family with ohranjati/ohranjanje: the official entry is guard/protect, while these contexts denote preservation, invariance, or conservation.
Use one uninflected replacement string: that would corrupt finite verbs, passive participles, and the shranjenje noun paradigm.
Rewrite every sentence with ostavati: several sites are conservation-law nouns or passive preservation constructions, so a single syntactic recast would lose distinctions.
